<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Reserved constituencies:</strong> The Supreme Court has dismissed petitions seeking the rotation of SC/ST reserved parliamentary and assembly seats, ruling that such policy decisions fall under the exclusive purview of Parliament.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPaE9ZdWlYQmlOdXM1Xy01cEtQb0c2RDFJejJDZGJUNWV1ZXBPdkFPdVNOelJHSmtXa2s0cmRHWDVISUJQRTJHNk9ObHFsU2FkVTQyTVF2QkJDNkthallJT0pPNWlCV3lFOUZKY0VZM0N3Zm9UcFZ6UHBEdFZRQ1ZaU0I2TGxZR0VhRDFiSmNiUzJJSTN5VGNXSm5mdXFSUl8yRW5QMU1OTTI0RUE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political sparring:</strong> Union Minister Kiren Rijiju has challenged Rahul Gandhi to debate his foreign visits in Parliament, while the BJP continues to insist that the legislature is the appropriate forum for such political discourse.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>
</ul>

<ul class="digest-points">
